findings.title: Release packaging accepts executable output that is not bound to the reviewed commit
findings.originalTrigger: Ignored stale dist could be archived as current HEAD.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: Fresh committed-source rebuild replaces stale Worker and client assets; failed build produces no archive.
findings.legitimateControl: Default/custom archive locations and ordinary migration files remain supported.

findings.title: Benchmark tools execute TypeScript selected by a Git ref with ambient Node authority
findings.originalTrigger: Unreviewed Git-selected TypeScript could execute top-level Node code.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: All three entry points reject malicious commit IDs and aliases before source execution; Git replacements are disabled.
findings.legitimateControl: Reviewed default core/backend and both historical reading comparisons retain equivalent results.

findings.title: Learning-journal tombstones can grow shared D1 storage without an account-level quota
findings.originalTrigger: Deleted event rows bypassed live-row caps and nonexistent date deletion allocated hidden days.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: 100000 retained event IDs and 64 MiB accounted storage enforced atomically; empty-date deletion rejected; quota failures fully roll back.
findings.legitimateControl: Idempotency, account isolation, migration backfill and privacy deletion/replay protection pass, including full-capacity cases.

findings.title: Nested DOCX paragraphs can amplify text on the browser main thread
findings.originalTrigger: Nested DOCX paragraphs/text nodes repeatedly copied descendants on the browser UI thread.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: Bounded markup preflight and one-pass nearest-paragraph extraction; constructed nested input is no longer amplified.
findings.legitimateControl: Normal/strict Word XML, tables, text boxes, CDATA and entities retained.

findings.title: Public provenance outputs disclose metadata and a share URL for private project material
findings.originalTrigger: Private project brief metadata appeared in the public generator and both manifests.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: Private hard-coded object and both output copies removed; targeted inspection finds no private brief/share metadata.
findings.legitimateControl: 19 public vocabulary sources, 12 textbooks and all 18 pinned source records remain.

findings.title: Vendored agent guidance recommends executing an unlocked registry package
findings.originalTrigger: Two vendored skill copies recommended executing an unlocked registry optimizer.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: Both executable recommendations replaced by reviewed/locked local-tool guidance.
findings.legitimateControl: Manual precision examples retained; no new application dependencies.

findings.title: Cleared personal articles remain readable and exportable in the current tab
findings.originalTrigger: Clearing IndexedDB left mounted reader body/list/export and import state alive.
findings.proofNoLongerReproduces: Committed personal-library replacement invalidates reader state in current and hidden second tabs; stale saves remain fenced.
findings.legitimateControl: Normal reading/import controls pass and unrelated learning-backup restoration does not clear personal library.

verificationGates.name: security triggers, alternate inputs and legitimate controls
verificationGates.review: One fresh independent read-only review completed; confirmed quota rollback issue remediated and covered by an additional assertion.

commands.environment: local workerd/D1; includes migration 0009 and actual quota trigger rollback

additionalFinding.title: Single-article removal lacks per-ID cross-tab invalidation and a deletion fence against delayed saves of the same ID.
additionalFinding.scope: Separate from whole-library clear; requires an article-specific lifecycle change to preserve unrelated in-progress imports.

deliveryState.privateDriveSharing: not modified; historical commits may retain prior metadata
